mechanism_narrative: A sustained 5-month contraction in GDP growth (GDPC1) below 1.5% signals weakening aggregate demand, which depresses corporate earnings expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) when GDPC1 < 1.5% for 5 months.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the industrial production index (INDPRO) above 2.5% signals accelerating supply-side activity, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when INDPRO > 2.5% for 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle, which increases discount rates and depresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for 2 months.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.5% signals labor market weakness, which reduces consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) when UNRATE > 4.5% for 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month decline in the housing starts index (HOUST) below 1.2 million units signals weakening residential construction activity, which depresses related sectors and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) when HOUST < 1.2M for 2 months.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the retail sales index (RSAFS) above 2.5% signals accelerating consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when RSAFS > 2.5% for 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month rise in the personal income index (PAYEMS) above 2.5% signals accelerating household income growth, which boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when PAYEMS > 2.5% for 2 months.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 3.5% signals accelerating inflation, which raises discount rates and depresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) when CPIAUCSL > 3.5% for 3 months.
